text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale General holds 88 units of gemcitabine hydrochloride with a daily use of 2.8, providing 31 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 13 units of the 2 g/52.6 mL 52 mL vial with a daily use of 1, providing 13 days on hand. The current product label identifies Mylan Labs Ltd as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage database does not list gemcitabine hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply at Lakeside is limited to 13 days. General has adequate stock for 31 days. No national shortage is reported by FDA. Alternative manufacturers have product available but their labels do not identify manufacturing plants we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Avyxa Pharma, LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Limited; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Gland Pharma Limited; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate and purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc.; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No action that assumes a national shortage exists or that changes clinical dosing.
